verdict.rationale: The only SDK-related evidence is Unit's API docs linking an official repository named unit-finance/openapi-unit-sdk. The docs present it as the home of the OpenAPI 3.0 spec rather than describing installable language SDKs. The Postman collection and sandbox help developers build integrations, but they are not SDKs. Missing for 10: documented official SDK packages per language, install and usage docs, SDK reference or versioning, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
